title: Drift-invariant kernels for discount curve models
abstract: arXiv:2611.09751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernel ridge regression estimates the discount curve as the minimizer of a pricing error plus a penalty given by the norm of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. By the representer theorem, the estimate lies in a finite-dimensional affine space that depends only on the kernel and on the cash flow dates of the instruments. We ask when this space is invariant under the risk-neutral drift of the discount curve, so that the estimated curves can be the states of a continuous-time arbitrage-free model. We show that this holds for every grid of cash flow dates if and only if the kernel is of the form $k(x,y)=\e^{b(x+y)}\big(c\,\e^{axy}+1-c\big)$, apart from kernels whose Hilbert space has dimension at most two. For this kernel the estimated curve is an affine combination of flat discount curves, each corresponding to a constant continuously compounded yield. translated_title: 面向贴现曲线模型的漂移不变核函数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.09751v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：核岭回归通过最小化定价误差并加上再生核希尔伯特空间范数形式的惩罚项来估计贴现曲线。根据表示定理，估计结果位于一个有限维仿射空间中，该空间仅取决于核函数和金融工具的现金流日期。我们研究在何种条件下该空间在贴现曲线的风险中性漂移下保持不变，从而使估计出的曲线能够成为连续时间无套利模型的状态。我们证明，对于任意现金流日期网格，当且仅当核函数具有形式 $k(x,y)=\e^{b(x+y)}\big(c\,\e^{axy}+1-c\big)$ 时（希尔伯特空间维数不超过二的核函数除外），该不变性成立。对于这种核函数，估计出的曲线是平坦贴现曲线的仿射组合，其中每条平坦贴现曲线对应一个恒定的连续复利收益率。漂移不变的子空间对应于现金流日期的子网格，并且...
tldr: 本文证明了核岭回归估计的贴现曲线在风险中性漂移下保持不变的充要条件是核函数具有特定的指数乘积形式，从而使估计曲线可作为连续时间无套利模型的状态。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that kernel ridge regression estimates of the discount curve are invariant under the risk-neutral drift if and only if the kernel takes a specific exponential-product form, enabling estimated curves to serve as states of continuous-time arbitrage-free models.
